dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Thick as the soft clouds are, the sweet dew simply refuses to descend...

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Greetings. I am Zhangsun Jijing, known to some as the Rainbearer. Back in the day, my teacher passed down to me the Guhua Brotherhood's secret sword technique, "Raincutter" — a style in which the sword carries the power of the rain, with movements that flow and dazzle...

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: In my humble opinion, since I am to coalesce the power of the rain onto the sword, I must wait for the rain to fall before I commence my practice.

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, nothing ever changes in this place. The clouds may come and go, but never has a drop of rain come down.

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: And how can I possibly "cut" without the rain? All the time one could ask for, and yet my sword technique has scarcely improved...
